items.source_en:
When it comes to the crates, the crew is on a need to know basis. 

Fact is, I've been working this side job for the last four missions. There's the regular work, and there's the shipping of this xenofauna. One job provides the perfect cover for the other.

That is, so long as the crew doesn't start asking the wrong questions. Otherwise there may need to be some shuffling when we get back to <Token.Title=MiscText03>. As <Alias.CurrentName=DerelictCaptain>, that's within my authority.
items.legacy_ko:
상자에 관해서는, 승무원들은 알 필요가 있는 것만 알면 된다.

items.source_en:
Date: 6-6-2324
Codename: Halcyon
Location:
Operator: Dr. Joseph Leonard

More problems have arisen. Reverting to manual controls proved to be a multi-day challenge, as I sabotaged more of the ships systems than I intended to when writing and installing CAPS. In retrospect, I should have run diagnostics and simulations on those systems as well. Live and learn.

Or learn, at least.

I believe I have gotten the controls back online, but there is another problem; CAPS's last series of jumps consumed almost all of our fuel. I should have enough to get into range to call for help. But its going to be close.

Next time I hire a test pilot.

아니면 적어도 배우는 거죠.

제어 장치를 다시 온라인 상태로 만들었다고 생각하지만, 또 다른 문제가 있습니다. CAPS의 마지막 일련의 중력 도약에서 연료를 거의 다 소모했습니다. 도움을 요청할 수 있는 범위까지 갈 만큼의 연료는 남아 있을 겁니다. 하지만 아슬아슬할 겁니다.
